def save_filter(db, label, name):
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO saved_filters (label, name) VALUES (?, ?) "
        "ON CONFLICT(label) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name",
        (label, name),
    )
    return None


def search_saved_filter(db, label):
    cur = db.execute(
        "SELECT p.id, p.name FROM products AS p "
        "WHERE p.name = (SELECT name FROM saved_filters WHERE label = ?) "
        "ORDER BY p.id ASC",
        (label,),
    )
    return [(row[0], row[1]) for row in cur.fetchall()]
